description: The logic for parsing keywords (raw_keywords_map → validate_and_normalize_keywords → Vec<Keyword>) and mailboxIds (filter true values → Vec<Id>) is copy-pasted verbatim in handle_email_import (email.rs:1742-1768, 1718-1740) and handle_email_copy (email.rs:2047-2073, 2023-2045). These blocks are identical except for the key names used in error messages. Suggested rewrite: extract parse_keywords(entry, key_name) -> Result<Vec<Keyword>, Value> and parse_mailbox_ids(entry, key_name) -> Result<Vec<Id>, Value> as shared private helpers.
title: Email/set and Email/import duplicate keyword+mailboxIds parsing code
